name: setdomainname
description: setdomainname() sets the NIS domain name of the host system to the value specified in the name array. It operates on the domain name associated with the calling process’s UTS namespace.

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: The number of bytes in the name array.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: name pointed outside of user address space.
len was negative or too large.
The caller did not have the CAP_SYS_ADMIN capability in the user namespace associated with its UTS namespace.
